title: Design the scope-guard role (Artemis with Demeter's cost view)
summary: Docs-only design for a role that weighs improvement work's value against cost before it is queued or dispatched, and watches running work for thrash. The goal is for Sri (and later design reviewers) to see how it decides, what it may stop or merge, what goes to Sri, and how learning work keeps flowing. The mapping Artemis (boundaries and scope) with Demeter (cost) is confirmed from the BRIEF.md pantheon table.

defaults_applied.how: Figures cite sources or are labeled estimates; thresholds marked as estimates.
Design written with alternatives and a decision entry before any build.
Written for an outside reader, with the pantheon names explained.
Criteria check the test's decisions and thresholds applied to the cited cases.
Design must show its signals would have caught the cited incidents.
Each rule is marked enforced by code or prose-only.
One design, one decision entry, no code.
Verifier runs cargo test and fmt check for docs-consuming tests.
No personal data or secrets in the docs.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: a reviewable design so Sri can approve the role before any build; audience is Sri and the independent verifier.

Mapping confirmed: Artemis (Boundaries: scope, side effects, impact beyond the request) is the role's identity, Demeter (Sustainability: resource and long-term cost) supplies the cost side. Reading from the BRIEF.md pantheon table, lines 603-607.
The next decision number is D127 (the latest is D126 in docs/decisions.md).

The role is mostly rules in code on records (retries, plan growth, cost against forecast), with a model only for judging value of a free-text request; stops are at job boundaries, consistent with D105.
Learning work (BRIEF.md addendum of 2026-10-25) gets a protected path: doubt resolves to proceed, never silent drop.
The trailer-job and prompt-budget figures come from the request; the producer should look for them in docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md and label them unverified if not found.
Docs/decisions are not in a governed list requiring athena.toml changes; no governance files change.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/scope-guard.md states the value-versus-cost test: the value side names the failure class, goal or product need served and how often it bites, each with a source; the cost side gives an expected cost in dollars and wall time, labeled as an estimate or measured; and a worked decision rule says when work is queued, merged, deferred or dropped.

The design grounds itself in the record with cited figures: the trailer job's three rejected attempts and about 11 dollars before the split, about 80 minutes lost to the prompt-budget trap, and the 49 open requests of which many were done or superseded. Each figure cites its source in the repository (decision, record or BRIEF.md line) or is labeled as the request's claim and unverified.

It lists thrash signals with numeric thresholds (repeated retries, growing plans, cost against forecast p90), says each threshold's basis or marks it as an estimate to be tuned, and shows each signal would have fired on the trailer job and the prompt-budget trap.
It separates rules from a model: which decisions code makes, which use a model and why, and what a model's verdict may not override.

It lists the role's powers: what it can stop or merge on its own, what is only advisory, and what goes to Sri, with the escalation channel. It states that learnings work (BRIEF.md addendum of 2026-10-25) is not blocked, with a mechanism such as a protected quota, a default to proceed on doubt, and a way to appeal.

It states its relation to the steward, Hestia and the planning keep rule (job-planning.md section 9), and confirms or changes the Artemis/Demeter mapping against the BRIEF.md pantheon table, with reasons.

It includes a build plan as a numbered list of jobs, each sized for one producer run (a stated scope, files touched and an acceptance check per job), ordered by dependency, with no code written in this change.
docs/decisions.md gains one new entry after D126, numbered D127 and marked proposed, in the existing format (Case, Decision, alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost), linking to the design.
CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased entry naming the design document and the proposed decision.
Run `cargo test` and `cargo fmt --check`: the repository's document and decision-format tests (if any check docs/decisions.md numbering, spec or non-Rust inventory) still pass with the new files.

out_of_scope: Any Rust code, tests or configuration implementing the role
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows
Actually closing or merging the 49 open requests
Designing the Hermes/Hestia context and knowledge engineer role
departures: Larger than the reference: a long design document with a worked build plan, plus a decision entry, needs more reading of existing decisions and more producer output.
urgent_reason: Priority is high, and the role exists to cut wasted work such as rejected attempts, thrash and redo; but this request only asks for a design, so it is not marked urgent.
